CL.rule: CHARTER 10 / P2B_PLAN step 2: (a) income rises with terrain-relative apex incl. pit swings; (b) crouch change <= 10 % of the +1 cm lift payoff; (c) income 1-10 % of tracking; (d) swing-min <= 5 %

TG.rule: CHARTER 10 / P2B_PLAN step 2: (e) pre-fall cost >= 5x walking; (f) cost 1-5 % of tracking
TG.episode_reward_units: TensorBoard Episode_Reward: per-episode weighted sum / 40 s; eval episodes at their own rate scaled to a 40-s episode (a fall shortens it); rows mixed 0.5 suite + 0.31 field_hard + 0.19 field_light
